title: IN WHICH THE BAG OF BANKNOTES DISGORGES SOME THOUSANDS OF POUNDS MORE
summary_hover: Fogg and Passepartout are arrested in Calcutta for Passepartout's earlier pagoda desecration, but Fogg pays exorbitant bail so they can catch their steamer.
summary_detail: Upon arriving at the station in Calcutta, Fogg, Passepartout, and Aouda are arrested and brought before Judge Obadiah. They discover the detective Fix has orchestrated charges against them for Passepartout's accidental desecration of a Bombay pagoda. Sentenced to prison and heavily fined, Fogg unhesitatingly pays two thousand pounds in bail, allowing the party to rush to the harbour and board the steamer 'Rangoon' for Hong Kong, leaving Fix in despair.
